girdi.command: ls -R core | head -60 && echo "---" && cat AGENTS.md
girdi.description: List core tree and read AGENTS.md

girdi.command: cd core/hooks && grep -n "^function short\|^function lastText\|^function job\|^const LEDGER\|LEDGER =" defter.js | head; echo "--- short body ---"; sed -n "/^function short/,/^}/p" defter.js; echo "=====COUNT handle/file/sum====="; sed -n "/^function file/,/^}/p;/^function sum/,/^}/p;/^function handle/,/^}/p" count.js; echo "=====strings dur.*====="; grep -n '"dur\.\|"banner\.' ../strings.json | head -40
